purpose: Create a source-bound, save-worthy LinkedIn infographic explaining why context management is becoming the practical bottleneck for AI agents.
audience: AI builders, product leaders, and technical operators who know agent terminology but need an operational model they can use.
intended_change: The reader stops treating the context window as a storage bin and starts managing it as a finite working budget.
source_authority: Fresh primary engineering sources and recent research, retrieved 2026-08-08. Trend selection is an explicitly labeled synthesis.
assumptions: The user wants a new Loomfile, not a continuation.
No relevant creator brand or voice files were supplied, so a neutral technical-editorial voice is used.
The existing Santa Cruz Strength brand files are unrelated and must not influence this campaign.
The primary desired behavior is save, with comments as the secondary signal.
American English is used because no creator locale was supplied and the active environment is California.
constraints: Self-contained runtime with local or embedded assets
No quantitative chart without comparable verified data
Body text at or above 12.5 source pixels
No em dashes, curly quotes, or AI-cliche phrasing in publishable copy
open_questions: Creator attribution and brand lockup remain intentionally blank pending user direction.
